idea-plugin.name: Percipience Context Engineering OS
idea-plugin.description:
⚡ Percipience Context Engineering OS (Free Community & Enterprise)

Autonomous Context Engineering, Real-Time AST Skeletonization, Merkle State Ledger, and Cross-Plugin Sandbox Governance for JetBrains IDEs.

🌟 Core Capabilities & Features (Free Community Tier)

  • 🚀 Interactive Workspace Prompt & Bootstrapping: Automatically detects unconfigured workspaces on startup and prompts the user to initialize the Quad-Space structure, Free Master Plan, billing config, and .nb/bin/percipience binary.
  • 💻 Unified Percipience CLI: Run commands directly in the workspace via ./.nb/bin/percipience or interactive IDE Control Plane buttons.
  • 🌲 Real-Time PSI AST Token Pruning: Traverses JetBrains Program Structure Interface (PSI) syntax trees in memory (<35ms) to compress code contexts by 60%–80% before LLM consumption.
  • 🛡️ Cryptographic Merkle Ledger: Continuous SHA-256 hash-chained state tracking for every prompt, code edit, and agent action with automated recovery points.
  • 🔄 Basic Autonomous CI/CD Pipeline: Out-of-the-box self-sustaining hygiene, AST token reduction, contract verification, and bounded auto-repair for the Free Community Tier.
  • 🔒 Cross-Plugin Sandbox Permission Broker: Brokers source access for third-party LLM plugins (JetBrains AI, GitHub Copilot, Continue, Cody), enforcing AST token reduction and WORM ledger immutability.
  • 📊 Status Bar Metrics Display: Live status bar telemetry widget displaying real-time token savings percentage and Merkle chain health.

🚀 Quick Start Guide

  1. When creating or opening a new workspace, click "🚀 Initialize Free Workspace" on the notification prompt.
  2. Execute commands via the "Percipience OS" Tool Window or the Tools -> Percipience menu.
  3. Run commands from the terminal: ./.nb/bin/percipience gate or ./.nb/bin/percipience audit.
  4. View live metrics directly in the bottom Status Bar (⚡ Percipience: 70.0% Saved | 🛡️ Merkle: OK).

  • Added PercipienceExecutionService for asynchronous command execution directly inside IntelliJ.
  • Added Control Plane actions for PR Gatekeeper, Merkle Audit, Basic CI/CD, Layer Validation, and Token Savings Summary.
  • Full Free Community Tier compliance matching .nb/config/billing_plans.yaml.
